text:
Sarah: @product FYI — Ledgerly (enterprise) just reported a sudden p95 jump on their dedicated cluster after today's deploy. Chat endpoints going from ~800ms -> ~2.6s. They want an ETA. :rotating_light:

Jordan: this is the one with the annual contract, repros on multiple regions. Sales asks we treat as high priority.

Anna: adding to intake. @Mike @Lee can you confirm regression vs baseline? Need impact, repro steps, and quick mitigation options.

Mike: looking now. Oncall dashboards show cluster-wide p95 increase starting ~08:12 UTC coincident with release tag r-2026.03.21-5. Early signs: KV cache miss ratio spiked and backend queueing rose. Sending logs in a sec.

Lee: SRE here — saw autoscaler oscillation around the same time, pods flapping which will amplify tail latency. Suspect recent batching heuristic change. Pulling traces.

Priya: Support — have customer request id 0x4b2f with sample trace. Minimal log snippet below: 

```
2026-03-21T08:12:34Z WARN kv_cache: miss_ratio=0.82
2026-03-21T08:12:36Z ERROR serve: req_id=0x4b2f latency=2600ms backend_queue=320ms
```

Dashboard: https://redwooddash/internal/clusters/ledgerly?range=1h (internal)

Mike: quick mitigation options: 1) pin Ledgerly to older model variant (v2-quant) that uses different batching path, 2) route them to low-latency pool (avoid affected batchers), or 3) revert batching heuristic in canary. Option 1/2 are fast but need product signoff for per-customer routing.

Anna: product decision: short-term mitigation approved for customer-critical accounts. Jordan — can you ask Ledgerly for a 2-3 hour maintenance window so SRE/Eng can apply routing pin and smoke test? Also want this added to backlog with clear acceptance criteria and rollback plan.

Jordan: Customer is ok with maintenance window 09:00-11:00 UTC. Confirmed.

Lee: I'll open a rollback PR to revert the batching heuristic in canary, but need eng-runtime signoff to push to prod after smoke.

Mike: I can do rollback + smoke tests, estimate ~45 minutes once PR is merged. Will queue it if product greenlights.

Anna: OK — marking P0 for next 24h response. Backlog action items (product):
- Reproduce the reg locally with captured traces and a minimal reproducer
- Validate rollback/mitigations on staging with smoke tests
- Restore p95 < 800ms for Ledgerly cluster within 24h of mitigation
- Customer communication template & postmortem scheduled

Priya: Drafting customer status update now, will paste here for review.

deploy-bot: Deploy r-2026.03.21-5 rolled to canary at 08:10 UTC.

Mike: creating backlog ticket ENG-1452 with labels: customer-impact, hotfix, p0. Will include reproducer and traces.

Anna: please also add acceptance criteria and rollback steps in the ticket, and assign eng-runtime + eng-sre. Tagging product for verification post-fix.

Jordan: confirmed Ledgerly accepts maintenance slot. They're asking for ETA on mitigation completion once started.

Anna: we'll communicate ETA once rollback/mitigation starts. Thanks all. :pray:
